elements.label: Figure 7.14
elements.title: AI Art Created by Craiyon.
elements.details: A 3x3 grid of nine AI-generated images showing surreal paintings of horses sitting at a bar, each drinking a cherry milkshake. Each image varies in style and horse depiction but follows the same prompt.
elements.summary: This figure shows nine different AI-generated images created by Craiyon from the prompt 'A surreal painting of a horse sitting at a bar, drinking a cherry milkshake.' It illustrates the variability and creativity of AI art generation.
